decision_right_or_constraint: Chooses eligible purchase/work/protection and supplies authority/ownership evidence.
grounded_scope: Toyota subsequent-owner reporting and published programme conditions.
incentive_hypothesis_not_observed: Minimize combined cost, uncertainty and inconvenience.
material_conflict: Better terms can still fail if model or budget is unsuitable.
customer_at_risk_of_exclusion: Undocumented new owner or disputed custody.

decision_right_or_constraint: Operates vehicle; may deliver or report incident without being legal payer.
grounded_scope: OEM booking permits another deliverer; fleet monitoring exists.
incentive_hypothesis_not_observed: Minimize downtime and effort, possibly not total asset cost.
material_conflict: Driving/consent authority is not spending or telemetry-access authority.
customer_at_risk_of_exclusion: Contractors or family driver without owner documentation.

decision_right_or_constraint: Shares budget/use allocation; exact purchase authority is case-specific.
grounded_scope: Fresh narratives show backup-car use and family agreement.
incentive_hypothesis_not_observed: Prefer safety, service confidence, liquidity or familiar brands.
material_conflict: One member benefits from EV while another carries long-trip/charging effort.
customer_at_risk_of_exclusion: One-car household; member whose preferences are not captured.

decision_right_or_constraint: Selects purchase/rental contract subject to company delegation.
grounded_scope: Commercial BEV rental partners and OEM fleet programme are published.
incentive_hypothesis_not_observed: Optimize total obligation, risk and procurement approval.
material_conflict: Lowest acquisition price versus usable duty cycle and residual risk.
customer_at_risk_of_exclusion: Small firms without financing or eligible rental terms.

decision_right_or_constraint: Plans actual operating windows and care access; authority differs by employer.
grounded_scope: G-Fleet provides mileage/location/reminders; commercial BEV context exists.
incentive_hypothesis_not_observed: Avoid missed shifts, idle assets and driver disruption.
material_conflict: Fleet dashboard visibility is not authority to approve a repair.
customer_at_risk_of_exclusion: Night shifts, specialized payloads, no spare vehicle.

decision_right_or_constraint: Publishes journey/terms and governs permitted handoff under actual company policy.
grounded_scope: Existing Single ID/SAM systems and OEM/partner channels, not their private role permissions.
incentive_hypothesis_not_observed: Conversion, useful assisted completion and coherent data.
material_conflict: More sharing can expose former-owner data or duplicate established OEM journeys.
customer_at_risk_of_exclusion: Digitally excluded owners or users lacking authorization.

decision_right_or_constraint: Controls local fulfillment within delegated rules; OEM/insurer terms remain external.
grounded_scope: Published booking/dealer-installation routes; actual local delegation not public.
incentive_hypothesis_not_observed: Capture feasible work and use capacity profitably.
material_conflict: Referring a budget job can preserve ecosystem trust while reducing branch ticket.
customer_at_risk_of_exclusion: Older cost-sensitive cars or unsupported specialist jobs.

decision_right_or_constraint: Explains a model/offer and assists a purchase; cannot bind lender or unsupported guarantee.
grounded_scope: Working finance/test-drive routes; lender intermediary boundary.
incentive_hypothesis_not_observed: Reach a completed suitable delivery within targets.
material_conflict: An attractive guarantee or charger story can exceed verified terms.
customer_at_risk_of_exclusion: Rejected credit, no stock, no feasible charging arrangement.

decision_right_or_constraint: Diagnoses/quotes/executes work within capability and delegated approval.
grounded_scope: Official service and record conditions plus OtoXpert light-work scope.
incentive_hypothesis_not_observed: Safe repair, understandable authorization and efficient workshop flow.
material_conflict: Remote explanation cannot create stock, trained labor or valid diagnostic evidence.
customer_at_risk_of_exclusion: Unlisted model, high-voltage specialist need, disputed fault.

decision_right_or_constraint: Verifies fitment, supply and channel terms; variant-level data untested.
grounded_scope: T-OPT model/category expansion and official-part conditions.
incentive_hypothesis_not_observed: Supply useful parts with realizable margin.
material_conflict: Cheaper suitable fast-moving parts can cannibalize a higher-ticket choice.
customer_at_risk_of_exclusion: Unlisted variants; stock shortages; customers needing battery assembly rather than consumable.

decision_right_or_constraint: Accepts/executes repair; payer authorization and network conditions can bind scope.
incentive_hypothesis_not_observed: Complete approved repair and control rework/cycle time.
material_conflict: A dealer booking cannot authorize insurer expense or guarantee parts timing.
customer_at_risk_of_exclusion: Uninsured collision, non-network repair or absent evidence.

decision_right_or_constraint: Defines affected VINs, warranty/campaign protocols and connected-product terms.
grounded_scope: OEM recall, warranty and G-Fleet programmes.
incentive_hypothesis_not_observed: Product safety, quality, brand retention and viable channel support.
material_conflict: Dealer offers must fit OEM technical and contract boundaries.
customer_at_risk_of_exclusion: Vehicles outside campaign or programme criteria.

decision_right_or_constraint: Sets underwriting/contract and residual obligations it actually accepts.
grounded_scope: SEVA intermediary limits; KINTO/commercial rental precedents.
incentive_hypothesis_not_observed: Fund eligible risk profitably with sufficient information.
material_conflict: Sales conversion versus rejected credit; private-use versus commercial contract.

decision_right_or_constraint: Insurer adjudicates covered claims; distributor scope depends on actual agreement.
grounded_scope: Motor exclusions/SPK and OJK distribution rules in first wave.
incentive_hypothesis_not_observed: Price accepted risk, handle claims, maintain valid distribution.
material_conflict: Customer-facing floor or SOH promise may exceed insured recovery.
customer_at_risk_of_exclusion: Excluded powertrain, cause/use or unaccepted residual exposure.

decision_right_or_constraint: Controls the bid it is willing to honor; certificate alone does not bind valuation.
grounded_scope: OLX indicative/inspection distinction; Hyundai used tiers.
incentive_hypothesis_not_observed: Buy condition risk at a viable resale price.
material_conflict: Customer values a health document; buyer may not accept its protocol or pricing effect.
customer_at_risk_of_exclusion: High mileage, uncertain battery history or thin market.

decision_right_or_constraint: Would approve subsidy, future-value liability and any risk-transfer capacity under actual delegation.
grounded_scope: Different capped/full-floor/RVI obligations are derived from stated structures.
incentive_hypothesis_not_observed: Incremental contribution after subsidy, adverse selection and residual loss.
material_conflict: Customer promise persists even if an insurer denies or caps recovery.
customer_at_risk_of_exclusion: Nonstandard cohorts can be expensive to serve but excluding them narrows demand.

actor_or_lens: Utility, installer and building permission owners
decision_right_or_constraint: Different parties control electrical connection, qualified installation and property permission.
grounded_scope: PLN home readiness; no building-specific permission inspected.
incentive_hypothesis_not_observed: Safe infrastructure and accepted operating obligations.
material_conflict: Dealer guidance cannot grant property permission.
customer_at_risk_of_exclusion: Renters, shared parking or inadequate electrical arrangement.

decision_right_or_constraint: Actual authorized custody and disposal scope must be established separately.
grounded_scope: Manual hazard warning, not an available local disposal service or entitlement.
incentive_hypothesis_not_observed: Safe accepted handling and economically viable collection.
material_conflict: A battery-condition record cannot establish disposal or reuse authority.
customer_at_risk_of_exclusion: No accessible qualified route; unclear title to removed battery.
